preconditions.expression: all(len(A[0]) == len(s) for s in A)
preconditions.description: All strings in A have the same length.
Each string in A has at least one character.

preconditions.expression: all(all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in s) for s in A)
preconditions.description: Each character in every string is a lowercase letter.

postconditions.expression: return_value == min(len(D) for D in possible_deletion_sets(A))
postconditions.description: The returned value is the minimum size of any set of deletion indices D such that after deleting characters at those indices from every string in A, every resulting string is in lexicographic order.

postconditions.expression: all(len(s) >= 1 for s in [s[list(set(range(len(s))) - D)] for s in A])
postconditions.description: For the minimal D, no resulting string is empty (i.e., at least one character remains in each string after deletions).

postconditions.expression: all(s[i] <= s[i+1] for s in [s[list(set(range(len(s))) - D)] for s in A] for i in range(len(s)-1))
postconditions.description: For the minimal D, every resulting string is in lexicographic order (each character is less than or equal to the next).
